0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the access-control + chain-registry initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls every registry setter and the fan-out).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a chain-registry diamond — seeds AccessControl (every registry setter and the {ChainRegistry.addEvmChain} fan-out are `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`-gated) and registers the IChainRegistry interface via ERC-165. There are NO module config params: the registry starts empty and is populated post-deploy by the admin. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open).
